column1: # Swedish (sv) catalog. Columns, separated by a TAB:  context <TAB> source <TAB> translation
#   context  empty          a plain UI string; `source` is the English text in the code (`tl!("…")`,
#                           a menu label, or a name the UI translates with `i18n::t`)
#   escapes  \n  \t  \\  inside a column. `{name}` placeholders must appear in both columns;
#            translators may reorder them. A trailing "…" (dialog commands) is kept.
#   lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored.
# Clean-room: every entry was written from the plain meaning of the English text using ordinary
# Swedish video-editing vocabulary (spår, spelhuvud, sekvens, korg, snitt, nyckelbildruta,
# undertext, rendera…). No proprietary localisation resource, string table or product UI was
# consulted or copied, and no other FilmCraft catalog was translated from; add entries the same
# way. Product, technology and format names (FilmCraft, ArtCraft, Lumetri, ProRes, LUFS, H.264…)
# keep their spelling, as do key-cap names (Shift, Alt, Ctrl, Cmd, Opt, Esc).
# Labels use sentence case; commands are imperatives; Delete = Radera, Remove = Ta bort,
# Clear = Rensa; decimals use a comma and frame rates are written bild/s (29,97 bild/s).
